purpose: Deterministic warm-up contract: per platform × activity, the ordered steps with preconditions, success criteria, allowed/forbidden actions, failure modes with recoveries, and budgets. Checked against the Swift registry by Tests/WarmUpTasksContractTests.swift.

invariants.rule: Every warm-up starts with the account step; no engagement action is valid before it finishes.
One planner decision executes at most one phone input, chosen from the CURRENT frame; history is never proof.
The runner, not the planner, owns step transitions, item counts, and the advance gesture (exactly one swipe, then verification).
Irreversible submissions fail closed: checkpoint written before the tap, OCR-labeled control required, never resubmitted, uncertain → needsInput.
Coordinates are fractions 0…1; percent and pixel answers are normalized, never rejected outright; one rejected answer is retried with the reason.
Every step has a decision and time budget; exhausting it ends in needsInput with the step id and last evidence, never a silent 300-step burn.
invariants.enforcedBy: PhoneVisualRunner.run per-step budget pass via stepBudget closure + WarmUpContractStore (budgets decoded from this file)

invariants.rule: Long videos (> maximumVideoDurationSeconds) are skipped with one swipe and never counted as viewed.
Watch runs make zero likes, follows, comments, or messages; comment/post runs publish at most one item.

TikTok.accountLocation: Tap the Profile tab at the bottom right. The @username appears under the display name at the top of the profile.

watch.successCase: itemsCompleted reaches itemLimit with each item watched to completion on a verified distinct video; zero likes/follows/comments; run status completed

steps.title: Verify account
successCriteria: Tap the Profile tab at the bottom right. The @username appears under the display name at the top of the profile.
OCR shows '@' + persona.handle (case-insensitive) in the profile header on the CURRENT frame
no sign-in / account-picker surface visible

failureModes.detection: screen.state == foregroundApp and OCR finds 'Log in' / 'Sign up' / 'Continue with'
failureModes.recovery: needsInput: never sign in, sign out, switch accounts, or enter credentials

failureModes.detection: OCR handle (case-insensitive, '@' stripped) != persona.handle
failureModes.recovery: needsInput with both handles in the message

failureModes.detection: profile visible but no '@' token with confidence >= 0.6 after 3 fresh frames
failureModes.recovery: one AssistiveTouch Home, reopen app, retry profile navigation once; then needsInput

failureModes.detection: screen.state == home or another app's chrome
failureModes.recovery: openApp primitive (Dock icon, else Spotlight) then re-verify; max 2 attempts

steps.title: Search niche
successCriteria: Open TikTok search; type the query; suggestions visible; do NOT submit
OCR shows the typed 1–2 word niche query in the search field

failureModes.detection: typed text absent from OCR after typeText
failureModes.recovery: tap the observed search field once, re-verify focus on a fresh frame, then retype; max 2 attempts

failureModes.detection: typed query > 2 words or > 32 chars
failureModes.recovery: selectAll + typeText with the 1–2 word niche term

failureModes.detection: typeText rejected for non-US characters
failureModes.recovery: needsInput: persona niche must be plain ASCII

steps.title: Choose search result
preconditions: query visible with suggestion list beneath the field
successCriteria: tapped one of the TOP THREE suggestions using its displayed wording
video results grid (Videos tab) visible on the next frame

failureModes.detection: no suggestion rows under the field after 2 frames
failureModes.recovery: press enter once, then verify the results grid

failureModes.detection: profile opened instead of grid
failureModes.recovery: back, re-tap a suggestion row

steps.title: Find video with >10K hearts
successCriteria: full-screen player is playing
HEART count next to the heart icon reads > 10,000 (10.1K / 25K / 1M qualify; 10K, 10.0K, 10,000 do not)
candidate chosen from the TOP of results, scrolling only if needed

failureModes.detection: player absent; profile header or 'Sponsored'/'Ad' label visible
failureModes.recovery: press back / AssistiveTouch Home, reopen results, pick the next top-row thumbnail

failureModes.detection: results exhausted within step budget
failureModes.recovery: needsInput; never lower a threshold or broaden the query

failureModes.detection: heart count not legible in player
failureModes.recovery: go back; inspect the next relevant result

steps.title: Watch to completion
preconditions: player (or post) is foreground on the CURRENT frame
successCriteria: timestamped frames show progress to the end, an observed ending, or a verified replay (counted once)

failureModes.detection: playback timer static across 2 frames >= 3 s apart and play glyph visible
failureModes.recovery: one tap on the observed play control, re-observe

failureModes.detection: 3 consecutive wait decisions with unchanged timer
failureModes.recovery: runner injects PhoneSearchGuidance.playbackCompletionReview; if still unchanged, treat as advance

failureModes.detection: readable or estimated total > maximumVideoDurationSeconds
failureModes.recovery: swipe up exactly once; do not count as viewed; cursor jumps to advance

failureModes.detection: screen.state != foregroundApp or player chrome missing
failureModes.recovery: openApp + re-run open step; do not count the item

steps.title: Like video
preconditions: runner scheduled a like for this item within the daily cap
successCriteria: the heart on the watched video is filled red after one tap

failureModes.detection: heart already filled red before any tap
failureModes.recovery: skip the like; never tap a filled heart

failureModes.detection: heart not filled red after the tap
failureModes.recovery: skip without tapping again (a second tap unlikes)

steps.title: Follow creator
preconditions: runner scheduled a follow for this item within the daily cap
successCriteria: the follow plus badge on the creator avatar is gone or shows a checkmark after one tap

failureModes.detection: no follow plus badge on the creator avatar
failureModes.recovery: skip the follow

failureModes.detection: plus badge still visible after the tap
failureModes.recovery: skip without tapping again

steps.title: Next video
successCriteria: a different video (caption/author changed) is playing after one upward swipe

failureModes.detection: identity tokens (caption/author) unchanged after swipe + wait
failureModes.recovery: wait 1 s and re-observe once; then needsInput (no second swipe)

failureModes.detection: grid thumbnails visible instead of player
failureModes.recovery: run open step again; do not swipe a grid

comment.successCase: one comment visible under the persona's handle beneath the watched video; checkpoint confirmed

tasks.title: Contract parity test
tasks.outcome: This file cannot drift from the Swift registry: identifiers, versions, step order and titles are asserted per platform × activity.
acceptance: swiftc test passes for all 12 scripts
every step has ≥1 successCriteria and ≥1 failureMode with a recovery
task ids unique; dependsOn resolves

tasks.title: Coordinate unit normalization
tasks.outcome: Planner answers in pixels or percent are converted to fractions instead of failing the step.
acceptance: CodexPhonePlannerTests unit cases pass

tasks.title: Retry with rejection reason
tasks.outcome: One malformed answer is re-asked with the rejection text; all planners share the path.
acceptance: PhoneVisualRunnerTests.retryNamesTheRejection passes

tasks.title: Load steps from this contract
tasks.outcome: WarmUpScript.steps reads instructions, budgets and allowed/forbidden actions from the bundled JSON; the Swift string switch becomes the fallback only.
acceptance: WarmUpScriptTests pass with JSON-sourced steps
version bump required to change any step

tasks.title: Local precondition observer per step
tasks.outcome: Before each planner call the runner checks screen.state and the step's OCR anchors locally; a failed precondition routes to the step's failureModes instead of a free planner decision.
acceptance: each failureMode.id in this file maps to one recovery branch
runner test per failure id

tasks.title: Per-step budgets
tasks.outcome: Enforce budget.maxPlannerDecisions / maxSeconds per step id; exhaustion → needsInput naming the step and last evidence.
acceptance: INV-6 enforcedBy updated to code
runner test: budget exhaustion never sends input after the limit

tasks.title: Deterministic navigation primitives
tasks.outcome: openApp (Dock, else Spotlight), goHome (AssistiveTouch), openSearch per platform become scripted local sequences with verification frames, removing planner freedom for chrome navigation.
acceptance: primitive tests with golden frames
planner never asked to locate the Home tab or search icon

tasks.title: Local OCR account check
tasks.outcome: The account step compares the OCR'd '@' token to persona.handle on the Mac; the planner only navigates to the profile.
acceptance: mismatch and signed-out fixtures → needsInput with zero engagement input
match fixture → step finishes without a planner claim

tasks.title: Submit-control label registry
tasks.outcome: submitControlLabels per platform drive PhoneSubmissionGuard; unlabeledControlRisk platforms (TikTok/YouTube comment send icons) get a glyph template match or stay needsInput.
acceptance: guard rejects any label not in the registry
fixtures per platform

tasks.title: Golden screenshot fixtures
tasks.outcome: One frame per platform × step (success and each failure id) checked into Tests/Fixtures for offline verification of TASK-5/7/8/9.
acceptance: every step id in this file has ≥1 fixture
fixtures are <300 KB each

tasks.title: Per-step journal outcomes
tasks.outcome: DeviceRunJournal records step id, attempt count, failureMode id and evidence so a failed run names the step, not just 'Failed'.
acceptance: Stage row shows last step id + failure id
journal round-trips through WarmUpScriptCheckpoint

tasks.title: Cross-platform parity gate
tasks.outcome: CI-equivalent script runs TASK-1 plus every planner/runner suite; a platform missing any step, budget, or recovery fails the build.
acceptance: bun run test exits non-zero on any parity or suite failure
